summary.decision_summary: Bend & Snap Count won by 36.0. Bend & Snap Count left 9.0 lineup points on the table, while Sigma Chi Whiteout left 10.2.
summary.historical_summary: Bend & Snap Count is 13-16 against Sigma Chi Whiteout across 29 meetings between these managers.
summary.ideal_summary: Ideal lineups still favor Bend & Snap Count
summary.winner_reason: Bend & Snap Count won by 36.0, led by a 23.3-point edge at QB. The leading starters were Joe Burrow (27.7) and Jaylen Warren (24.6).
summary.loser_reason: Sigma Chi Whiteout could not match the opponent's QB production, losing that position battle by 23.3 points. Drake Maye scored 4.4. A best legal lineup added 10.2, still short of the 36.0-point margin.
